name: Hammer
description: A single bullish reversal candle that forms after a downtrend. It has a small real body near the top of the candle's range and a long lower wick at least 2 times the body length, indicating that sellers drove price down but buyers reclaimed most of the losses by close.

body_rules.body_position: must be in the upper third of the total candle range
body_rules.body_color: preferably bullish (green/white) but bearish body is still valid with confirmation

wick_rules.lower_wick: must be at least 2 times the length of the real body
wick_rules.upper_wick: little to none; upper wick should be no more than 10-15% of the total range
wick_rules.wick_direction: the long wick must point downward

context_requirement: must form at or near a defined support level after a downtrend of at least 3-5 candles; hammer in an uptrend or ranging market is not a hammer pattern
volume_requirement: volume on the hammer candle should be higher than the average of recent candles; high volume adds strong confirmation
agent_rules: Only trade hammer at a confirmed support zone, trendline, or Fibonacci level
Require a bullish confirmation candle closing above the hammer's high before entering long
Stop loss should be placed below the hammer's low
A hammer with very high volume is a stronger signal than a hammer on low volume
Do not trade a hammer that gaps far away from price context
A bearish-bodied hammer (inverted color) requires stronger confirmation from the next candle
The longer the prior downtrend, the more significant the hammer reversal signal
